endpoint_checks.copernicus_legacy_prism_download: TCP/TLS connection timed out after 15 seconds
endpoint_checks.cdse_stac: reachable in 1.18 seconds, but the advertised collections did not include Copernicus DEM
endpoint_checks.cdse_odata: reachable, but no COP-DEM_GLO-30 or Copernicus_DSM products were returned
endpoint_checks.cdse_sentinel_hub_process_api: supports COPERNICUS_30 AOI processing but requires CDSE OAuth credentials; throughput not tested

endpoint_checks.nisar_stage_dem_py: installed script reads s3://nisar-dem; anonymous direct access returned HTTP 403

decision: Use credential-free AWS COP30 COG tiles with eight resumable ranges and a local tile cache. Retain OpenTopography for AW3D30_E. Keep CDSE as a future authenticated provider and benchmark it before changing the default.
